name: SpectrumOS Workshop (Meridian)
remarks: OPTIONAL FALLBACK ONLY. The workshop runs on local installs.
If a laptop blocks a local install, open the starter-repo folder in a cloud dev environment (for example GitHub Codespaces) so the participant can still take part.
This container provides Node, installs the app dependencies, and installs the SpectrumOS CLI from vendor/. The Playwright responsive test is optional and not needed to take part.
Claude Code must still be authenticated inside the container. SpectrumOS is bundled in vendor/ and its CLI is installed here; run 'spectrum-os' once to wire the /spec-* commands into ~/.claude.
